subtitle.en: The Imam Who Revived the Kongo Mosque

meta.en: Era: 1920s–1934 (revived the Kongo Mosque c. 1927–1932; died 1934)
meta.sw: Kipindi: Miaka ya 1920–1934 (aliufufua Msikiti wa Kongo karibu 1927–1932; alifariki 1934)
meta.dg: Wakati: Miaka ya 1920–1934 (waufufula Msikiti wa Kongo chiasi cha 1927–1932; wafwa 1934)

meta.en: Role: Swahili Muslim scholar, imam of the Khonzi Mosque in Mombasa, reviver of the Kongo Mosque and promoter of the maulid among the Digo
meta.sw: Jukumu: Mwanazuoni Mwislamu wa Kiswahili, imamu wa Msikiti wa Khonzi mjini Mombasa, mfufuaji wa Msikiti wa Kongo na mhamasishaji wa maulidi miongoni mwa Wadigo
meta.dg: Kazi: Msomi Mswahili wa dini ya Chiislamu, imamu wa Msikiti wa Khonzi iko Mombasa, ariyeufufula Msikiti wa Kongo na ariyeeneza maulidi kahi za Adigo

meta.en: Region: Mombasa and Diani, Kwale County, present-day Kenya
meta.sw: Eneo: Mombasa na Diani, Kaunti ya Kwale, Kenya ya leo
meta.dg: Phatu: Mombasa na Diani, Kaunti ya Kwale, Kenya ya rero

blocks.en: Shaykh Mwinyikombo bin Makame, remembered in Diani as Sheikh Mwinyi Kombo, was not a Digo. He was a Swahili scholar from Mombasa. His mother was a Kilindini and his father came from Pemba. Yet he has a place in Digo history. In the late 1920s he persuaded the elders of Diani that an overgrown ruin on their shore, where people went to make offerings to spirits, was a mosque. He then reopened it for prayer. The Kongo Mosque has been the Friday mosque of Diani ever since. The maulid celebrations he led there spread across Digo country in the early 1930s.
blocks.sw: Shaykh Mwinyikombo bin Makame, anayekumbukwa Diani kama Sheikh Mwinyi Kombo, hakuwa Mdigo. Alikuwa mwanazuoni wa Kiswahili kutoka Mombasa. Mama yake alikuwa Mkilindini na baba yake alitoka Pemba. Hata hivyo ana nafasi katika historia ya Wadigo. Mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1920 aliwashawishi wazee wa Diani kwamba gofu lililofunikwa na vichaka kwenye ufuo wao, ambako watu walikwenda kutoa sadaka kwa mizimu, lilikuwa msikiti. Kisha akaufungua tena kwa ajili ya swala. Tangu hapo Msikiti wa Kongo umekuwa msikiti wa Ijumaa wa Diani. Sherehe za maulidi alizoziongoza pale zilienea katika nchi ya Wadigo mwanzoni mwa miaka ya 1930.
blocks.dg: Shaykh Mwinyikombo bin Makame, anayetambukirwa iko Diani dza Sheikh Mwinyi Kombo, kala si Mdigo. Kala ni msomi Mswahili kula Mombasa. Nineye kala ni Mkilindini na ise kala ni wa Pemba. Ela ana phatu kahi za historia ya Adigo. Mwisho wa miaka ya 1920 waashawishi azehe a Diani akubali kukala gofu ririrokala kanda ya ufuwo wao, ririrofunikpwa ni vitsaka na ambapho atu kala anaphiya kulavya sadaka kpwa mizimu, kala ni msikiti. Chisha wauvugula tsona kpwa kuvoya. Kula wakati uho Msikiti wa Kongo ukakala msikiti wa Ijumaa wa Diani. Sherehe za maulidi ariyozilongoza phapho zaenea kahi za tsi ya Adigo mwandzo wa miaka ya 1930.

blocks.en: Who He Was
blocks.sw: Alikuwa Nani
blocks.dg: Kala ni Ani

blocks.en: What we know of Mwinyikombo comes mainly from interviews that the historian David Sperling recorded in Diani, Mtongwe and Chitsanga in 1987, with people who still remembered him. His full name was **Mwinyikombo bin Makame**. One informant explained that his mother was a **Kilindini** and his father a **Pemba** man "who had close ties with the Tangana". The Kilindini and the Tangana are two of the Three Tribes (*Miji Mitatu*) of the Mombasa Swahili. So his family belonged to the Swahili world of Mombasa and Pemba, which had traded and intermarried with the Digo for centuries.
blocks.sw: Tunayoyajua kuhusu Mwinyikombo yanatoka hasa katika mahojiano ambayo mwanahistoria David Sperling aliyarekodi Diani, Mtongwe na Chitsanga mwaka 1987, na watu waliokuwa bado wanamkumbuka. Jina lake kamili lilikuwa **Mwinyikombo bin Makame**. Mhojiwa mmoja alieleza kuwa mama yake alikuwa **Mkilindini** na baba yake alikuwa mtu wa **Pemba** "aliyekuwa na uhusiano wa karibu na Watangana". Wakilindini na Watangana ni makabila mawili kati ya Makabila Matatu (*Miji Mitatu*) ya Waswahili wa Mombasa. Kwa hiyo familia yake ilikuwa sehemu ya ulimwengu wa Kiswahili wa Mombasa na Pemba, ambao ulikuwa umefanya biashara na kuoana na Wadigo kwa karne nyingi.
blocks.dg: Mambo hunagomanya kuhusu Mwinyikombo ganakula hasa kpwa mahojiano ambago mwanahistoria David Sperling wagarekodi iko Diani, Mtongwe na Chitsanga mwaka 1987, na atu ambao kala achere anamtambukira. Dzinare kamili kala ni **Mwinyikombo bin Makame**. Mutu mmwenga ariyehojiwa wagomba kukala nineye kala ni **Mkilindini** na ise kala ni mutu wa **Pemba** "ariyekala na uhusiano wa phephi na Atangana". Akilindini na Atangana ni makabila mairi kahi za Makabila Mahahu (*Miji Mitatu*) ga Aswahili a Mombasa. Phahi mbariye kala ni ya dunia ya Chiswahili ya Mombasa na Pemba, ambayo kpwa karne nyinji kala ikahenda biashara na kulolana na Adigo.

blocks.en: At the time of the Kongo revival he was **imam of the Khonzi Mosque in Mombasa**, well known for the maulid he held there. The maulid is the celebration of the Prophet Muhammad's birth, with recited praise-poems. With Sayyid Amin of Takaungu and Muhammad Mbwana he formed what Sperling calls "a triumvirate of maulid supporters", who attended maulid celebrations up and down the Kenya coast.
blocks.sw: Wakati wa kufufuliwa kwa Kongo alikuwa **imamu wa Msikiti wa Khonzi mjini Mombasa**, akijulikana sana kwa maulidi aliyoyafanya pale. Maulidi ni sherehe ya kuzaliwa kwa Mtume Muhammad, yenye kughani mashairi ya kumsifu. Pamoja na Sayyid Amin wa Takaungu na Muhammad Mbwana aliunda kile ambacho Sperling anakiita "watetezi watatu wa maulidi", waliohudhuria sherehe za maulidi kote katika pwani ya Kenya.
blocks.dg: Wakati wa kufufulwa kpwa Kongo, kala ni **imamu wa Msikiti wa Khonzi iko Mombasa**, anamanyikana sana kpwa maulidi ariyokala anagahenda phapho. Maulidi ni sherehe ya kuvyalwa kpwa Mtume Muhammad, ambayo nkusomwa mashairi ga kumtogola. Phamwenga na Sayyid Amin wa Takaungu na Muhammad Mbwana, waunda kundi ambaro Sperling anariiha "atu ahahu ariokala anatetea maulidi", ambao kala anahudhuria sherehe za maulidi pwani yosi ya Kenya.

blocks.en: The Mosque in the Bush
blocks.sw: Msikiti Uliokuwa Porini
blocks.dg: Msikiti wa Weruni

blocks.en: The Kongo Mosque stands at the northern end of Diani beach, on the south bank of the Mwachema River (also called the Tiwi or Kongo River), in the locality known as Kongo. Its age and builders are not known. It is a coral-stone building, roofed with barrel vaults and domes, under great baobab trees. Archaeologists have found 14th-century pottery near Tiwi, and pottery from the other ruined settlements nearby suggests they began in the 15th or 16th century. The archaeologist James Kirkman thought the mosques of this stretch of coast might be as recent as the 18th century. Popular accounts often say the mosque was built in the 13th or 14th century, but no excavation has confirmed this. One suggestion, made cautiously by Sperling, is that the builders of the old mosques at Tiwi, Diani, Kongo and Ukunda were Kilindini Swahili. The Kilindini lived on the mainland south of Mombasa before moving to the island after 1593.
blocks.sw: Msikiti wa Kongo uko upande wa kaskazini wa ufuo wa Diani, kwenye ukingo wa kusini wa Mto Mwachema (unaoitwa pia Mto Tiwi au Mto Kongo), katika eneo linalojulikana kama Kongo. Umri wake na waliouujenga havijulikani. Ni jengo la mawe ya matumbawe, lenye paa la matao na makuba, chini ya mibuyu mikubwa. Wanaakiolojia wamepata vyungu vya karne ya 14 karibu na Tiwi, na vyungu vya makazi mengine yaliyobomoka yaliyo karibu vinaonyesha kuwa yalianza karne ya 15 au ya 16. Mwanaakiolojia James Kirkman aliona kwamba misikiti ya sehemu hii ya pwani huenda ni ya karibuni kama karne ya 18. Masimulizi maarufu mara nyingi husema msikiti ulijengwa karne ya 13 au ya 14, lakini hakuna uchimbuaji uliothibitisha hilo. Pendekezo moja, lililotolewa kwa tahadhari na Sperling, ni kwamba wajenzi wa misikiti ya zamani ya Tiwi, Diani, Kongo na Ukunda walikuwa Waswahili wa Kilindini. Wakilindini waliishi bara kusini mwa Mombasa kabla ya kuhamia kisiwani baada ya mwaka 1593.
blocks.dg: Msikiti wa Kongo unaphahikana mwisho wa kazikazini wa ufuwo wa Diani, kanda ya kusini ya Muho wa Mwachema (unaoihwa piya Muho wa Tiwi au Muho wa Kongo), phatu phanaphoihwa Kongo. Umriwe taumanyikana, wala arioudzenga taamanyikana. Ni nyumba ya mawe ga sanoo, yenye dari ya matao na makuba, photsi ya miuyu mikulu. Anaakiolojia akaphaha vidzaya vya nyungu vya karne ya 14 phephi na Tiwi, na vidzaya vya midzi yanjina ya kare iriyobanangika iriyo phephi vinaonyesa kukala midzi iyo yaandza karne ya 15 au ya 16. Mwanaakiolojia James Kirkman waona kukala misikiti ya seemu hino ya pwani inaweza kukala ni ya karibuni dza karne ya 18. Adisi zinazomanyikana ni atu anji mara nyinji nkugomba kukala msikiti uhu wadzengbwa karne ya 13 au ya 14, ela takuna utsimbadzi uriothibitisha dzambo hiri. Pendekezo mwenga, ririrogombwa kpwa tahadhari ni Sperling, ni kukala atu ariodzenga misikiti ya kare ya Tiwi, Diani, Kongo na Ukunda kala ni Aswahili a Kilindini. Akilindini kala anaishi bara kusini mwa Mombasa kabla ya kuphiya kuishi chisiwani bada ya mwaka 1593.

blocks.en: By the early 20th century the building was empty and overgrown, but people knew it was there. In 1914 the District Commissioner described a ruined mosque at Diani "in remarkable preservation, with the roof still on" but "badly overgrown". The government asked the Wakf Commission to pay for repairs, and the Commission refused. Traders knew it too. An Arab trader named Idi used to beach his boats near the Kongo Mosque to exchange cloth and maize for tobacco. For the Digo of Diani, the overgrown building had become a place of the spirits, *mizimu*, and they offered sacrifices there.
blocks.sw: Kufikia mwanzoni mwa karne ya 20 jengo hilo lilikuwa tupu na limefunikwa na vichaka, lakini watu walijua lilikuwepo. Mwaka 1914 Mkuu wa Wilaya alieleza msikiti uliobomoka huko Diani "uliohifadhika vizuri ajabu, na paa lake bado lipo", lakini "umefunikwa sana na vichaka". Serikali iliiomba Tume ya Wakfu kulipia ukarabati, na Tume ikakataa. Wafanyabiashara nao waliujua. Mfanyabiashara Mwarabu aitwaye Idi alikuwa akizileta mashua zake ufuoni karibu na Msikiti wa Kongo ili kubadilisha nguo na mahindi kwa tumbaku. Kwa Wadigo wa Diani, jengo hilo lililomezwa na vichaka lilikuwa limegeuka kuwa mahali pa mizimu, na walitoa sadaka pale.
blocks.dg: Kufikira mwandzo wa karne ya 20 nyumba hiyo kala taina mutu na ikafunikpwa ni vitsaka, ela atu kala anaimanya. Mwaka 1914 Afisa wa Wilaya waeleza msikiti uriobanangika iko Diani "uchere mzima kpwa namna ya ajabu, na dariye icherepho", ela "ukafunikpwa sana ni vitsaka". Serikali yavoya Tume ya Wakfu iriphe gharama za kuutengeza, na Tume ichikahala. Achuuzi nao kala anaumanya. Mchuuzi Mwarabu yeihwa Idi kala anaika madauge ufuwoni phephi na Msikiti wa Kongo ili kubadilishana nguwo na pemba kpwa tumbaku. Kpwa Adigo a Diani, nyumba hiyo iriyofunikpwa ni vitsaka kala ikakala phatu pha *mizimu*, roho za akare, na kala analavya sadaka phapho.

blocks.en: The Revival
blocks.sw: Ufufuo
blocks.dg: Kufufulwa

blocks.en: In the late 1920s Mwinyikombo set out to change this. As one Diani man told Sperling:
blocks.sw: Mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1920 Mwinyikombo aliazimia kubadilisha hali hii. Kama mwanamume mmoja wa Diani alivyomwambia Sperling:
blocks.dg: Mwisho wa miaka ya 1920 Mwinyikombo waamua kubadilisha hali hino. Dza mlume mmwenga wa Diani arivyomuambira Sperling:

blocks.en: "Mwinyikombo called the elders of Diani together and told them, 'Kongo is a mosque, it's not an mzimu. The people going there to slaughter chickens and things like that are desecrating it, that's wrong.' Mwinyikombo convinced them to revive the mosque."
blocks.sw: "Mwinyikombo aliwaita wazee wa Diani pamoja akawaambia, 'Kongo ni msikiti, si mzimu. Watu wanaokwenda pale kuchinja kuku na vitu kama hivyo wanaunajisi, na hilo ni kosa.' Mwinyikombo aliwashawishi waufufue msikiti."
blocks.dg: "Mwinyikombo waiha azehe a Diani phamwenga na achiaambira, 'Kongo ni msikiti, si mzimu. Atu anaophiya iko kutsindza kuku na vitu dza hivyo anaunajisi, na hiri ni kosa.' Mwinyikombo waashawishi akubali kuufufula msikiti."

blocks.en: The horn was sounded, and the villagers, Muslims and non-Muslims alike, turned out for a communal bush-clearing. The District Commissioner is said to have overseen the opening of a path to the mosque. Oral testimony names the DC as S. V. Cooke, which places the clearing between March and July 1927. In the same year, the colonial government is reported to have gazetted the mosque as a monument.
blocks.sw: Pembe ilipigwa, na wanakijiji, Waislamu na wasio Waislamu pia, walijitokeza kwa kazi ya pamoja ya kufyeka vichaka. Inasemekana Mkuu wa Wilaya alisimamia ufunguzi wa njia ya kuelekea msikitini. Ushahidi wa mdomo unamtaja Mkuu huyo wa Wilaya kuwa S. V. Cooke, jambo linaloweka kazi hiyo ya kufyeka kati ya Machi na Julai 1927. Katika mwaka huo huo, inaripotiwa kwamba serikali ya kikoloni ilitangaza msikiti kwenye gazeti la serikali kuwa mnara wa kumbukumbu.
blocks.dg: Mbiru yapigbwa, na atu a chidzidzi, Aislamu na atu ambao si Aislamu, achituluka kuhenda kazi ya phamwenga ya kutema vitsaka. Nkugombwa kukala Afisa wa Wilaya waimirira kutengezwa kpwa njira ya kuphiya msikitini. Ushahidi wa mromo unamtaja Afisa wa Wilaya hiye kukala ni S. V. Cooke, dzambo rinaroika kazi hiyo ya kutema kahi ya Machi na Julai 1927. Mwaka uho uho, nkugombwa kukala serikali ya chikoloni yatangaza msikiti kpwenye gazeti ra serikali kukala mnara wa kumbukumbu.

blocks.en: The mosque was not used for prayer until **1932**, when Mwinyikombo organised a maulid for its official opening. Digo Muslims came from all over Digo District, and Muslims came from other parts of the coast, including Sayyid Amin from Takaungu. In his homily, people remembered, he told the gathering to celebrate the maulid three times a year: "from now on this mosque is your Mecca." From then on Kongo was the Friday mosque for Diani. The people of Tiwi alternated, praying one Friday at Kongo and the next at home.
blocks.sw: Msikiti haukutumiwa kwa swala hadi mwaka **1932**, Mwinyikombo alipoandaa maulidi kwa ajili ya ufunguzi wake rasmi. Waislamu wa Kidigo walikuja kutoka kila pembe ya Wilaya ya Digo, na Waislamu walikuja kutoka sehemu nyingine za pwani, akiwemo Sayyid Amin kutoka Takaungu. Katika mawaidha yake, watu walikumbuka, aliwaambia waliokusanyika washerehekee maulidi mara tatu kwa mwaka: "kuanzia sasa msikiti huu ndio Makka yenu." Tangu hapo Kongo ukawa msikiti wa Ijumaa wa Diani. Watu wa Tiwi walipokezana, wakiswali Ijumaa moja Kongo na inayofuata nyumbani kwao.
blocks.dg: Msikiti taukahumirwa kpwa kuvoya hadi mwaka **1932**, Mwinyikombo ariphohenda maulidi kpwa kuuvugula rasmi. Aislamu a Chidigo akpwedza kula chila phatu pha Wilaya ya Digo, na Aislamu anjina akpwedza kula seemu zanjina za pwani; hata Sayyid Amin wakpwedza kula Takaungu. Atu anatambukira kukala, kahi za mawaidhage, waambira atu ariokusanyika atambukire maulidi mara tahu chila mwaka: "kula sambi msikiti uhu ni Makka yenu." Kula hipho Kongo uchikala msikiti wa Ijumaa wa Diani. Atu a Tiwi kala anavoya kpwa kuphisana: Ijumaa mwenga Kongo, na Ijumaa inayolunga kpwao kaya.

blocks.en: Teacher and Maulid Preacher
blocks.sw: Mwalimu na Mhubiri wa Maulidi
blocks.dg: Mwalimu na Mhubiri wa Maulidi

blocks.en: After the first maulid, Mwinyikombo began teaching religious knowledge (*'ilm*) at Kongo every Thursday after the evening prayer, to a group of seven or eight pupils from Diani and Tiwi. He kept up these classes until his death.
blocks.sw: Baada ya maulidi ya kwanza, Mwinyikombo alianza kufundisha elimu ya dini (*'ilm*) pale Kongo kila Alhamisi baada ya swala ya jioni, kwa kundi la wanafunzi saba au wanane kutoka Diani na Tiwi. Aliendelea na darasa hizo hadi kifo chake.
blocks.dg: Bada ya maulidi ga kpwandza, Mwinyikombo waandza kufundza elimu ya dini (*'ilm*) iko Kongo chila Alamisi bada ya mavoyo ga dziloni, kundi ra anafundzi sabaa au nane kula Diani na Tiwi. Waenderera na madarasa gago hadi ariphofwa.

blocks.en: He also took the maulid on the road. Between 1932 and 1935 public maulid celebrations spread to Mtongwe, Likoni, Vyemani, Pungu, Ng'ombeni, Matuga, Ukunda, Msambweni, Chikoneni and Lungalunga, usually with the recitation of the *Simt ad-Durar*. Mwinyikombo attended them, preached on the basics of the faith, and then went round asking people whether they were Muslims and whether they were married. If they were not married as Muslims, he married them on the spot. "He wasn't converting people," an informant recalled; "he was bringing them out of their state of ignorance and closer to their faith." Sperling concluded that the presence of eminent coastal scholars such as Mwinyikombo and Sayyid Amin "gave a new prestige to Digo Islam". One of the people Sperling interviewed put it more simply: "The maulid brought us the joy of the religion."
blocks.sw: Pia aliyapeleka maulidi vijijini. Kati ya 1932 na 1935 sherehe za maulidi za hadhara zilienea Mtongwe, Likoni, Vyemani, Pungu, Ng'ombeni, Matuga, Ukunda, Msambweni, Chikoneni na Lungalunga, kwa kawaida pamoja na kusomwa kwa *Simt ad-Durar*. Mwinyikombo alihudhuria, akahubiri juu ya misingi ya imani, kisha akapita akiwauliza watu kama walikuwa Waislamu na kama walikuwa wameoana. Ikiwa hawakuwa wameoana kwa ndoa ya Kiislamu, aliwafungisha ndoa papo hapo. "Hakuwa akiwasilimisha watu," mhojiwa mmoja alikumbuka; "alikuwa akiwatoa katika hali yao ya ujinga na kuwasogeza karibu na dini yao." Sperling alihitimisha kwamba kuwepo kwa wanazuoni mashuhuri wa pwani kama Mwinyikombo na Sayyid Amin "kuliupa Uislamu wa Wadigo hadhi mpya". Mmoja wa watu aliowahoji Sperling alilisema kwa urahisi zaidi: *"Maulid ilituletea furaha ya dini."*
blocks.dg: Piya wahala maulidi achiphiya nago vidzidzini. Kahi ya 1932 na 1935 sherehe za maulidi za hadhara zaenea Mtongwe, Likoni, Vyemani, Pungu, Ng'ombeni, Matuga, Ukunda, Msambweni, Chikoneni na Lungalunga, mara nyinji phamwenga na kusomwa kpwa *Simt ad-Durar*. Mwinyikombo kala anazihudhuria, anahubiri misingi ya imani, chisha anazunguluka achiuza atu ichikala ni Aislamu na ichikala akalolana. Ichikala kala taadzangbwelolana kpwa ndoa ya Chiislamu, kala anaaloza phapho phapho. "Kala kaasilimisha atu," mutu mmwenga ariyehojiwa watambukira; "kala anaatuluza kahi za uzuzu wao na kuareha phephi na dini yao." Sperling wamalizira kukala kukala kpwa asomi mashuhuri a pwani dza Mwinyikombo na Sayyid Amin "kuupha Uislamu wa Adigo hishima nyiphya". Mmwenga wa atu ambao Sperling waahoji wagomba kpwa maneno machache: "Maulidi gahurehera raha ya dini."

blocks.en: Shaykh Mwinyikombo died on 5 Safar 1353 AH, which was **20 May 1934**. People remembered that on the Saturday before, he had said: "The bull is going away, you won't see him again." On the Sunday he was taken by a fever and died.
blocks.sw: Shaykh Mwinyikombo alifariki tarehe 5 Safar 1353 AH, yaani **20 Mei 1934**. Watu walikumbuka kwamba Jumamosi kabla ya hapo alikuwa amesema, *"Fahali aenda zake, hutamwona tena."* Jumapili alishikwa na homa na akafariki.
blocks.dg: Shaykh Mwinyikombo wafwa tarehe 5 Safar 1353 AH, ambayo ni **20 Mei 1934**. Atu anatambukira kukala Jumamosi kabla ya hipho kala akagomba: "Ndzau anaphiya vyakpwe, kundamuona tsona." Jumapili wagbwirwa ni homa achifwa.

blocks.en: The Dream Tradition
blocks.sw: Mapokeo ya Ndoto
blocks.dg: Mapokeo ga Ndoso

blocks.en: Today the story told at the mosque is different. The caretaker and deputy imam, Sheikh Hamisi Suleiman, has told journalists that Mwinyi Kombo was commanded in a dream to look for a mosque along the Diani coastline, and found the old building at Kongo, "which had become a home for bats". Popular accounts often add that this happened about three hundred years ago. This is a living tradition of the mosque community. It is not found in the testimony Sperling recorded in 1987 from people who had known Mwinyikombo. The 1914 colonial report also shows that the building was known long before the revival. The "three hundred years" probably comes from the building's age being attached to the story of its revival.
blocks.sw: Leo hadithi inayosimuliwa msikitini ni tofauti. Mtunzaji na naibu imamu, Sheikh Hamisi Suleiman, amewaambia waandishi wa habari kwamba Mwinyi Kombo aliamrishwa katika ndoto kutafuta msikiti kando ya pwani ya Diani, na akalikuta jengo la zamani pale Kongo, "lililokuwa limekuwa makazi ya popo". Masimulizi maarufu mara nyingi huongeza kwamba haya yalitokea karibu miaka mia tatu iliyopita. Haya ni mapokeo hai ya jamii ya msikiti. Hayamo katika ushahidi aliourekodi Sperling mwaka 1987 kutoka kwa watu waliomjua Mwinyikombo. Ripoti ya kikoloni ya 1914 pia inaonyesha kwamba jengo hilo lilijulikana muda mrefu kabla ya ufufuo. Hiyo "miaka mia tatu" huenda inatokana na umri wa jengo kuunganishwa na hadithi ya kufufuliwa kwake.
blocks.dg: Rero adisi inayosemurirwa msikitini ni tafwauti. Muimirizi wa msikiti na naibu imamu, Sheikh Hamisi Suleiman, akaambira aandishi a habari kukala Mwinyi Kombo walagizwa ndosoni kuhendza msikiti kanda-kanda ya pwani ya Diani, na achiphaha nyumba ya kare iko Kongo, "iriyokala ikakala makalo ga nundu". Adisi zinazomanyikana ni atu anji mara nyinji nkuenjereza kukala dzambo hiri rahendeka chiasi cha miaka magana mahahu iriyotsupa. Iga ni mapokeo ganagoenderera kusemurirwa ni jamii ya msikiti. Tagaphahikana kahi za ushahidi ambao Sperling waurekodi mwaka 1987 kula kpwa atu ariommanya Mwinyikombo. Ripoti ya chikoloni ya 1914 piya inaonyesa kukala nyumba hiyo kala inamanyikana kare sana kabla ya kufufulwa. "Miaka magana mahahu" hiyo inawezekana inakula kpwa umri wa nyumba kuunganishwa na adisi ya msikiti kufufulwa.

blocks.en: The Mosque Today
blocks.sw: Msikiti Leo
blocks.dg: Msikiti Rero

blocks.en: The Kongo Mosque is one of the best-preserved old mosques on the south Kenya coast. Its roof of barrel vaults and domes is largely intact. The vaults over the prayer hall rest on three central columns, and the mihrab, the niche facing Mecca, is a plain arch opening into an undecorated apse. To the north are at least five old tombs, three of them large and nearly square, one with a panelled face under a frieze of small niches. Local tradition says the name Kongo comes from an inscription reading "Swaddiq Kongo" (or Siddiq Kongo) on one of the graves, but Kongo is also the name of the locality. The mosque has been renovated with cement and paint and extended to the east. It remains an active place of worship, and at Eid the crowds spill out onto the beach.
blocks.sw: Msikiti wa Kongo ni mmoja wa misikiti ya zamani iliyohifadhika vizuri zaidi katika pwani ya kusini ya Kenya. Paa lake la matao na makuba kwa kiasi kikubwa liko kamili. Matao juu ya ukumbi wa swala yamesimama juu ya nguzo tatu za katikati, na mihrabu, kishubaka kinachoelekea Makka, ni tao sahili linalofunguka kwenye kipenyo kisicho na nakshi. Upande wa kaskazini kuna angalau makaburi matano ya zamani, matatu kati yake makubwa na karibu ya mraba, moja likiwa na uso wenye vibao chini ya ukanda wa vishubaka vidogo. Mapokeo ya wenyeji yanasema jina Kongo linatokana na maandishi yanayosomeka "Swaddiq Kongo" (au Siddiq Kongo) kwenye mojawapo ya makaburi, lakini Kongo pia ni jina la eneo hilo. Msikiti umekarabatiwa kwa saruji na rangi na kupanuliwa upande wa mashariki. Bado ni mahali pa ibada panapotumika, na wakati wa Idi umati wa watu hufurika hadi ufuoni.
blocks.dg: Msikiti wa Kongo ni kahi za misikiti ya kare iriyosala na hali nono zaidi kahi za pwani ya kusini ya Kenya. Dariye ya matao na makuba kpwa seemu kulu ichere nzima. Matao ganagofunika ukumbi wa kuvoya ganaima dzulu ya nguzo tahu za kahi-kahi, na mihrabu, chishubaka chinacholengana na Makka, ni tao risiro na mapambo rinarovugulika kpwenye pango ridide risiro na nakshi. Uphande wa kazikazini kuna mbira za kare zisizopungua tsano, tahu kahi zao ni kulu na karibu za mraba, na mbira mwenga ina uso wenye vibao photsi ya mstari wa vishubaka vidide. Mapokeo ga atu a phapho ganagomba kukala dzina Kongo rinakula kpwa maandiko ganagosomeka "Swaddiq Kongo" (au Siddiq Kongo) kpwenye mbira mwenga, ela Kongo piya ni dzina ra seemu hiyo. Msikiti ukatengezwa tsona kpwa simiti na rangi, na ukaenjerezwa uphande wa mashariki. Uchere ni phatu pha kuvoya phanaphohumirwa, na wakati wa Idi umati wa atu nkuodzala hadi ufuwoni.

blocks.en: The colonial government listed the "Ruins at Diani" as a protected monument in 1929 (Gazette Notices 170 and 457), under the Ancient Monuments Preservation Ordinance of 1927. In 1983 Gazette Notice No. 440 declared the Kongo Mosque a monument.
blocks.sw: Serikali ya kikoloni iliorodhesha "Ruins at Diani" (Magofu ya Diani) kama mnara wa kumbukumbu unaolindwa mwaka 1929 (Matangazo ya Gazeti 170 na 457), chini ya Sheria ya Kuhifadhi Minara ya Kale ya 1927. Mwaka 1983 Tangazo la Gazeti Na. 440 lilitangaza Msikiti wa Kongo kuwa mnara wa kumbukumbu.
blocks.dg: Serikali ya chikoloni yaorodhesha "Ruins at Diani" (Magofu ga Diani) dza mnara wa kumbukumbu unaorindwa mwaka 1929 (Matangazo ga Gazeti 170 na 457), kulengana na Sheria ya Kurinda Minara ya Kare ya 1927. Mwaka 1983 Tangazo ra Gazeti Na. 440 ratangaza Msikiti wa Kongo kukala mnara wa kumbukumbu.

blocks.en: Mwinyi Kombo's Place in Digo History
blocks.sw: Nafasi ya Mwinyi Kombo katika Historia ya Wadigo
blocks.dg: Phatu pha Mwinyi Kombo Kahi za Historia ya Adigo

blocks.en: Sheikh Mwinyi Kombo was a Swahili scholar from Mombasa, not a Digo. His story is still part of Digo history, because the people who made the revival happen were Digo. The elders of Diani accepted his argument and gave up a shrine. The villagers cleared the bush. Digo Muslims filled the mosque at the 1932 maulid, carried the maulid to their own villages, and remembered all of this well enough to tell a historian about it half a century later. The revival of Kongo marks the point when Islam in Diani, which had grown slowly through traders, friends and a few village mosques, gained a shared centre and a public celebration of its own.
blocks.sw: Sheikh Mwinyi Kombo alikuwa mwanazuoni wa Kiswahili kutoka Mombasa, si Mdigo. Hata hivyo hadithi yake ni sehemu ya historia ya Wadigo, kwa sababu watu waliofanikisha ufufuo huo walikuwa Wadigo. Wazee wa Diani walikubali hoja yake na wakaacha mahali pao pa tambiko. Wanakijiji walifyeka vichaka. Waislamu wa Kidigo walijaza msikiti katika maulidi ya 1932, wakayapeleka maulidi katika vijiji vyao, na wakayakumbuka haya yote vizuri kiasi cha kumsimulia mwanahistoria nusu karne baadaye. Ufufuo wa Kongo unaashiria wakati ambapo Uislamu huko Diani, uliokuwa umekua polepole kupitia wafanyabiashara, marafiki na misikiti michache ya vijijini, ulipata kitovu cha pamoja na sherehe yake ya hadhara.
blocks.dg: Sheikh Mwinyi Kombo kala ni msomi Mswahili kula Mombasa, si Mdigo. Adisiye ichere ni seemu ya historia ya Adigo, kpwa sababu ariohenda kazi ya kuufufula msikiti kala ni Adigo. Azehe a Diani akubali hojaye na achiricha phatu pha kuasira. Atu a chidzidzi atema vitsaka. Aislamu a Chidigo aodzaza msikiti kahi za maulidi ga 1932, achihala maulidi achiphiya nago vidzidzi vyao, na achitambukira iga gosi vinono hadi achiweza kumsemurira mwanahistoria miaka hamsini badaye. Kufufulwa kpwa Kongo kunaonyesa wakati ambapho Uislamu wa Diani, uriokala ukakula pore-pore kpwa njira ya achuuzi, asena na misikiti michache ya vidzidzi, waphaha phatu pha kukusanyikira phamwenga, na shereheye ya hadhara.
